question: When was the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2010**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) was established in **2010**.
 
• GGGI is an international organization dedicated to supporting and promoting strong, inclusive, and sustainable economic growth in developing countries and emerging economies.
 
• It was initially founded as a think tank in South Korea and later transformed into an intergovernmental organization.
 
• The headquarters of GGGI is located in Seoul, South Korea.
